data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Attractions & Tickets, city, keyword, search, sort, open result) with the right parameters, but it omits the final action (view Nearby or add to favorites) and its parameter, and its steps are loose (it says "click or type in" the city box and doesn't name the sort options), so an automation would stop at opening the result and miss the last step.
